info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Insurance Claims Claims Deny-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Denial Management API allows users to efficiently manage and process denied insurance claims within the system. This DELETE operation provides the ability to remove specific denied claims from the records, streamlining claims management and improving operational efficiency. Typical consumers include insurance providers and claims processing teams who need to maintain accurate claim records. This API enhances the overall workflow by ensuring that only current and relevant claims are retained in the system.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to deny a specific claim. Use this operation when you need to officially reject a claim request, providing necessary details for the decision.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details necessary to deny a claim. Ensure all required fields are populated correctly to process the request successfully.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

DeleteInsuranceClaimsClaimsDenyRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation related to denying claims. It is expected to be a string value that conveys specific details or instructions regarding the operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the delete operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the delete operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the claim after the delete operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the delete request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's outcome.

DeleteInsuranceClaimsClaimsDenyResponse_.description: Response schema for the delete operation on claims denial.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed by an automated system.

AuditDetails.description: Details related to the audit of the claim deletion operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value helps in understanding the performance of the API operation.
